title: Blocked referrers no longer force ads
summary:
One focused fix corrected ad selection for blocked referrers, adjusted audio limits, and tightened diagnostics.

Ad selection now blocks referrers on the blocked-domain list instead of forcing ads for them.

The maximum input for `openai-audio` dropped from 5,000 to 2,000 characters, and both token limits for `gpt-4o-mini-audio-preview` are now 512.

Error-response logging now handles message collections without a reduce method. Image-parameter debug logging and a token-validation performance test were also added.
